report:
1 documented-standard finding (P2): ai/README.md:5 and ai/README.zh-CN.md:5 still label MiniMax China, while docs/barness-ai/contract.md:359 says BuiltinCatalog has no MiniMax formal models. This conflicts with AGENTS8/9 and ADR0042: the frozen tree already embeds three international M3 identities. Correct current documentation after the active gate closes, retaining full-release PARTIAL and M3.1 unknown qualifiers.

The complete pinned scope was assessed across protocol adapters/shared lifecycle, native-state isolation, exact numeric/request guards, cost/usage boundaries, actual-origin/ledger/capture verification, catalog activation, release artifact readers, finite paid authority/source applicability and retained evidence. No further documented standard breach or actionable baseline smell was identified. Protocol-specific policies remain scoped, real second-use helpers are shared, and immutable historical snapshots retain their original context.

This is static Standards review only. Earlier resolved findings and narrow reviews remain historical records; no fresh full-suite certificate or current gate result is claimed. The active gate and later documentation/evidence delta require separate result/metadata review.
